claims: "#SKYKING: Panic in the Sky" is a 2026 ABC News Studios documentary.
"#SKYKING: Panic in the Sky" premieres on April 14, 2026, on Hulu and Disney+.
"#SKYKING: Panic in the Sky" details the August 10, 2018, theft of a Horizon Air Q400 plane by Richard "Beebo" Russell.
Richard "Beebo" Russell was a ground agent for Horizon Air.
Richard "Beebo" Russell was a 29-year-old ground service agent for Horizon Air.
Richard "Beebo" Russell was described as a "broken guy" in recordings.
Richard "Beebo" Russell had no intention of hurting others.
Richard "Beebo" Russell sought to end his own life.
Richard "Beebo" Russell performed unauthorized aerobatic maneuvers over Puget Sound, including a barrel roll.
Richard "Beebo" Russell performed the maneuvers for 70 minutes before crashing on Ketron Island.
A Horizon Air De Havilland Dash 8-400 turboprop valued at $33 million was stolen from Seattle-Tacoma International Airport.
Richard "Beebo" Russell flew for roughly 70–75 minutes.
Richard "Beebo" Russell performed reckless maneuvers, including a barrel roll and flying upside down.
Richard "Beebo" Russell communicated with air traffic control.
Two F-15 Eagle fighter jets were scrambled to intercept the plane.
The F-15 Eagle fighter jets created a sonic boom.
The F-15 Eagle fighter jets did not fire upon the plane.
The aircraft crashed on Ketron Island, southwest of Tacoma.
The crash resulted in the death of Richard "Beebo" Russell.
"#SKYKING: Panic in the Sky" is directed by P.E. Gillespie.
"#SKYKING: Panic in the Sky" streams on Hulu and Disney+.
"#SKYKING: Panic in the Sky" includes interviews with family, friends, and air traffic controller Colleen.
Air traffic controller Colleen managed the crisis.
The documentary is also referred to as #SKYKING or SkyKing.
